# pedromarquezg.com
> Personal site of Pedro Márquez: Korean study notes (Seoul National University Korean 2–3) and small self-made Korean-learning products.

## Products
- [Korean by Roots — Free sample](https://pianodude.gumroad.com/l/korean-by-roots-free): free PDF with 3 Sino-Korean roots (학, 자, 실) and their word families, to try the method.
- [Korean by Roots — Starter ($3)](https://pianodude.gumroad.com/l/korean-by-roots-starter): 20 Sino-Korean roots × 5 words with example sentences in English and Spanish, as PDF, Anki deck and CSV, for TOPIK I/II learners.

## Pages
